name: Impact: Weapons and Explosions
author: wolfsdk
description: Raises two mix bus gains in soundmixing:default: 'Player Weapon' from -11 to -6 dB and 'Explosions' from -5 to -2 dB. The mix bus sits after the HDR stage, so it bypasses the precomputed rmsTable curves that could catch a volume boost at decl level again. 'World Sfx Master' is deliberately left alone because footsteps and vehicles hang off it too. Side effect: the master bus limiter (threshold -0.2 dB) kicks in earlier, so loud scenes may pump a little. Not confirmed in game: that changed sound decls take effect is inferred from the archive structure (same entry remainder as entityDef/weapon, no .bin counterpart like for particle), not observed. No audio file is touched; streamed.resources and english.streamed stay untouched.
